title: India's AI agent sprawl: Enterprises struggle with production beyond pilot stages
summary: Indian organizations are delving into AI agents across various sectors, yet a noticeable divide exists between experimental phases and full-scale implementation. This unchecked proliferation of agents resembles Shadow IT but poses even more substantial risks. Without proper management, these agents could result in security breaches and redundant expenses. Therefore, establishing robust governance and orchestration is essential for safe and efficient AI integration.
